identity.title: [C II] 158 μm Emission from z ∼ 4 H I Absorption-selected Galaxies

findings_qualitative.value: Five of six targeted high-metallicity z~4 DLAs have detected [C II] emitters, with impact parameters ~16-45 kpc

evidence.quote: we now have detected [C II] 158 $\mu$m emission from five of six galaxies associated with targeted high-metallicity DLAs at $z \sim 4$.

claims.hypothesis: High-metallicity z~4 DLAs can be associated with [C II]-emitting galaxies
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 7 search in four DLA fields
claims.result: [C II] emitters in three of four fields (five of six with earlier work)
claims.finding: [C II] is an efficient way to identify DLA galaxies

evidence.quote: We detect [C II] 158 $\mu$m emission from galaxies at the DLA redshift in three fields, with one field showing two [C II] 158 $\mu$m emitters.

claims.hypothesis: DLA galaxies resemble luminous LBGs in FIR properties
claims.experiment: Compare L_FIR vs L[CII] to other populations
claims.result: Similar to luminous LBGs and CSGs
claims.finding: Absorption-selected galaxies are similar to luminous LBGs

evidence.quote: The figure indicates that the FIR properties of galaxies selected through absorption are similar to those of luminous Lyman-break galaxies (LBGs) and color-selected galaxies (CSGs)

claims.hypothesis: The DLA arises in a companion galaxy rather than the [C II] emitter
claims.experiment: Compare emission and absorption line centroids
claims.result: Offsets <100 km/s for all five emitters

evidence.quote: This disfavors a scenario where the DLA arises from gas in a companion galaxy.

why_this_data.value: High-metallicity DLAs are best candidates for [C II] detection given the [C II]-SFR correlation

evidence.quote: further indicates that such high-metallicity DLAs are the best candidates for detections of [C II] 158 $\mu$m emission.

limitations_admitted.value: L_TIR from a single-wavelength continuum measurement has ~0.5 dex systematic uncertainty; some continuum associations are tentative

evidence.quote: Therefore, we tentatively take this as the continuum flux measurement of the [C II] 158 $\mu$m emitter.

referee_caveats_inferred: Low-significance detections (5.2 sigma) and 3.7-3.8 sigma continuum assignment
SMG in J1253 assumed at quasar redshift without line confirmation
